name: LangMem
problem_solved: AI agentlerin conversation-lardan oyrenmemesi ve her session-da eyni seyi yeniden sorushmasi
what_it_does: Agentler ucun long-term memory, memory extraction, prompt optimization ve LangGraph storage integration verir.
sample_project: Personal AI career coach that remembers user goals, preferred roles, rejected companies, and interview feedback.
before_after_angle: Before: stateless chatbot her defe sifirdan bashlayir. After: agent kecmish danishiqlardan istifade edib daha personalized cavab verir.
linkedin_hook: I gave an AI assistant long-term memory — and the hardest part was deciding what not to remember.

name: Mem0
problem_solved: LLM app-larda persistent user context ve personalization yoxlugu
what_it_does: Universal memory layer kimi user, agent ve session memory-ni saxlayir ve sonradan retrieve edir.
sample_project: Customer support assistant that remembers customer preferences, prior tickets, and unresolved issues.
before_after_angle: Before: support bot her ticketi ayri gorur. After: bot customer history-ne gore daha kontekstli cavab verir.
linkedin_hook: I tested Mem0 by turning a forgetful support bot into a memory-aware assistant.

name: Zep
problem_solved: Enterprise agentlerin dynamic business context-i ve conversation history-ni scale-da idare ede bilmemesi
what_it_does: Temporal knowledge graph esasli memory layer ile agentlere governed, low-latency context retrieval verir.
sample_project: Enterprise account assistant that tracks relationship changes, meetings, objections, and next actions.
before_after_angle: Before: CRM notes plain text kimi qalir. After: agent temporal relationship graph-dan istifade edir.
linkedin_hook: I tested graph-based memory for enterprise AI agents — vector search alone was not enough.

name: Graphiti
problem_solved: RAG sistemlerinde melumat deyishdikce knowledge graph-in yeniden batch rebuild teleb etmesi
what_it_does: Real-time temporal context graph qurur, yeni faktlari ve relationship deyishikliklerini incremental saxlayir.
sample_project: Meeting intelligence system that tracks how project decisions change over time.
before_after_angle: Before: son meeting note-lari static RAG-da itir. After: agent decision timeline ve relation changes gore bilir.
linkedin_hook: I built a temporal knowledge graph for meeting notes instead of another basic vector-search RAG.

name: Letta
problem_solved: Agentlerin uzun muddetli davranish, core memory ve archival memory-ni idare ede bilmemesi
what_it_does: Stateful agents qurmaq, memory blocks, archival memory ve self-improving behavior yaratmaq ucun platform verir.
sample_project: Coding mentor agent that remembers user's code style, weak areas, and learning plan.
before_after_angle: Before: coding assistant generic advice verir. After: assistant user-in tarixcesine gore mentoring edir.
linkedin_hook: I tested a stateful coding mentor that improves across sessions.

name: Supermemory
problem_solved: AI apps-da memory, user profile ve RAG pipeline-i ayrica qurmagin operasional yukunun cox olmasi
what_it_does: Memory API kimi ingestion, semantic search, user profiling ve context management verir.
sample_project: Personal knowledge assistant that remembers articles, notes, and user interests.
before_after_angle: Before: bookmark search keyword-based qalir. After: assistant user memory ve semantic context ile cavab verir.
linkedin_hook: I replaced bookmarks with an AI memory layer and tested how well it recalls useful context.

name: Cognee
problem_solved: Agentlerin documents, decisions ve workflows arasindaki relationship-leri anlamamasi
what_it_does: Documents ve structured/unstructured data-ni embeddings + graph memory ile queryable context-e cevirir.
sample_project: Internal policy assistant that connects policies, exceptions, owners, and change history.
before_after_angle: Before: RAG sadece similar chunk tapir. After: agent relationship graph ile daha derin reasoning edir.
linkedin_hook: I tested graph memory for RAG — and it changed how the agent reasons over documents.

name: Agno
problem_solved: Prototype agentleri production service kimi run, trace, schedule ve manage etmek cetinliyi
what_it_does: Agent platform qurmaq, RBAC, tracing, scheduling, memory, human review loops ve control plane verir.
sample_project: Data analyst agent that runs scheduled business KPI analysis and stores traces.
before_after_angle: Before: notebook demo manual ishleyir. After: scheduled, traceable agent service kimi ishleyir.
linkedin_hook: I moved an AI data analyst from notebook demo to managed agent service.

name: Browser Use
problem_solved: AI agentlerin real websites ile click, form fill, navigation ve extraction ede bilmemesi
what_it_does: Websites-i AI agents ucun accessible edir, browser automation-i natural language ve tools ile idarə edir.
sample_project: Job search agent that visits job boards, extracts matching roles, and creates a shortlist.
before_after_angle: Before: job search manual browser tabs ile edilir. After: browser agent repetitive browsing-i automate edir.
linkedin_hook: I built a job-search browser agent that collects matching AI roles automatically.

name: Stagehand
problem_solved: Selenium/Playwright selector-larinin brittle olmasi ve high-level AI browser actions ehtiyaci
what_it_does: act, extract, observe, agent primitives ile natural language + code browser automation verir.
sample_project: Competitor pricing monitor that navigates product pages and extracts structured prices.
before_after_angle: Before: CSS selector deyishende scraper sinir. After: AI-assisted extraction daha flexible olur.
linkedin_hook: I replaced brittle selectors with AI browser actions for a pricing monitor.

name: BAML
problem_solved: Promptlari string kimi idare etmek, versioning ve structured output reliability problemi
what_it_does: Prompt engineering-i schema engineering-e ceviren DSL ile reliable LLM functions qurur.
sample_project: PDF invoice extraction workflow with typed LLM functions and testable schemas.
before_after_angle: Before: prompts app code-un icinde daginikdir. After: BAML functions prompt+schema-ni maintainable edir.
linkedin_hook: I treated prompts like typed functions using BAML — and extraction became easier to test.

name: Guardrails AI
problem_solved: LLM input/output riskleri, PII leakage, unsafe content ve malformed structured data
what_it_does: Input/output guards, validators, risk detection ve structured data validation frameworkudur.
sample_project: Healthcare intake assistant with PII checks, safety filters, and structured output validation.
before_after_angle: Before: bot sensitive data-ni unchecked qaytarir. After: guards risky input/output-lari block ve validate edir.
linkedin_hook: I added guardrails to a healthcare chatbot and tested what gets blocked.

name: olmOCR
problem_solved: Linearizing PDFs for LLM/VLM datasets while preserving reading order, tables, equations, and complex formatting.
what_it_does: AllenAI toolkit for converting PDFs into clean text using VLM-backed OCR-style processing.
sample_project: Dataset builder that converts scanned PDFs into clean training/eval samples for document VLMs.
before_after_angle: Before: OCR output contains headers, footers, and broken order. After: cleaner linearized document text.

name: ModelScope ms-swift
problem_solved: Bir çox model və tuning metodunu vahid CLI/WebUI ilə idarə etmək.
what_it_does: TBD
sample_project: Eyni dataset üzərində LoRA vs DoRA vs LongLoRA müqayisəsi qur.
before_after_angle: Before: yalnız bir LoRA adapter. After: müxtəlif adapter metodlarının accuracy/latency/memory müqayisəsi.
linkedin_hook: I compared LoRA variants on the same domain dataset.

name: Axolotl
problem_solved: Complex LoRA/QLoRA, DPO, multimodal və MoE fine-tuning configuration-larını production-like şəkildə idarə etmək.
what_it_does: TBD
sample_project: MoE model üzərində yalnız expert weights üçün LoRA fine-tuning təcrübəsi et.
before_after_angle: Before: MoE model fine-tuning VRAM baxımından bahalıdır. After: expert-focused LoRA ilə daha ucuz adaptation.
linkedin_hook: LoRA for MoE models: what changes when you fine-tune experts?

name: AdapterHub Adapters
problem_solved: Bir neçə domain/task adapterini modular şəkildə train və reuse etmək.
what_it_does: TBD
sample_project: Bir base model üçün finance adapter + support adapter + Azerbaijani tone adapter konsepti qur.
before_after_angle: Before: hər task üçün ayrı model. After: modular adapters ilə task-specific behavior.
linkedin_hook: Can adapters become reusable AI skills?

name: m-LoRA
problem_solved: Çoxlu domain adapter train etmək istəyəndə GPU utilization və latency problemi.
what_it_does: TBD
sample_project: Eyni base model üçün 3 adapter train et: legal, finance, customer support.
before_after_angle: Before: adapterlər bir-bir train olunur. After: multi-LoRA scheduling ilə throughput müqayisəsi.
linkedin_hook: Training multiple LoRA adapters from one base model.

name: LoRAX
problem_solved: Hər fine-tuned model üçün ayrıca deployment xərci.
what_it_does: TBD
sample_project: 3 LoRA adapteri train et və LoRAX ilə dynamic adapter routing demo qur.
before_after_angle: Before: hər adapter üçün ayrı endpoint. After: shared base model + dynamic adapter loading.
linkedin_hook: Serving 10 specialized LoRA models without deploying 10 full models.

name: SimpleTuner
problem_solved: Image/video generative models üçün production-like LoRA training və job orchestration.
what_it_does: TBD
sample_project: Brand-style LoRA train et: eyni product visual identity-ni FLUX/SDXL modelinə öyrət.
before_after_angle: Before: image model brand style-ı saxlamır. After: LoRA ilə consistent brand visuals çıxır.
linkedin_hook: I trained a brand-style LoRA with SimpleTuner.

name: Honcho
problem_solved: Agent sadəcə memory saxlayır, amma user modelini reasoning ilə yeniləmir.
what_it_does: Stateful agents üçün people, projects, sessions və ideas üzərində reasoning memory layer verir.
sample_project: Personal productivity assistant that learns communication style and project priorities.
before_after_angle: Before: assistant reminder tool kimidir. After: assistant user modelinə əsasən proactive suggestions verir.

name: memU
problem_solved: 24/7 proactive agents user routines və long-term preferences-i strukturlaşdırmır.
what_it_does: Multimodal inputs-dan structured memory çıxarır və hierarchical memory file system yaradır.
sample_project: Proactive daily assistant that remembers routines, documents, images, and recurring preferences.
before_after_angle: Before: assistant yalnız user soruşanda cavab verir. After: assistant learned routine əsasında proactive help verir.

name: Metarank
problem_solved: Search və listing pages hamıya eyni nəticə göstərir.
what_it_does: Low-code learning-to-rank service ilə product listings, articles, search results və recommendations personalize edir.
sample_project: Personalized product search reranker using clicks, views, and purchases.
before_after_angle: Before: search results static relevance ilə sıralanır. After: ranking user behavior ilə personalize olunur.

name: Gorse
problem_solved: Product/content recommendations üçün backend sıfırdan yazılır.
what_it_does: Go-based open-source recommender engine; users, items və feedback əsasında recommendations yaradır.
sample_project: GitHub repository recommender based on stars, topics, and user interactions.
before_after_angle: Before: trending repos hamıya eyni göstərilir. After: user interests əsasında personalized repo list çıxır.

name: RecBole
problem_solved: Recommendation algorithms müqayisəsi üçün unified experiment framework yoxdur.
what_it_does: 100+ recommendation model və multiple recommendation task üçün PyTorch-based framework verir.
sample_project: Compare sequential vs collaborative filtering models on e-commerce click data.
before_after_angle: Before: random/trending product list. After: RecBole model user behavior-based top-N recommendations verir.

name: Cornac
problem_solved: Text, image və social features-i recommendation modelə daxil etmək çətindir.
what_it_does: Multimodal recommender systems üçün comparative framework verir.
sample_project: Fashion recommender using product images, descriptions, and user interactions.
before_after_angle: Before: only interaction-based recommendations. After: image/text metadata cold-start recommendations-i yaxşılaşdırır.

name: Vespa
problem_solved: Search, vector retrieval və ranking personalization ayrı sistemlərdə qurulur.
what_it_does: Search, vector search, tensor ranking və recommendation serving üçün scalable engine verir.
sample_project: Personalized news search with user embeddings and query-time ranking features.
before_after_angle: Before: search only query relevance ilə işləyir. After: user embedding və behavior ranking score-a daxil olur.

name: promptfoo
problem_solved: Prompt/model comparison cost-aware deyil.
what_it_does: Open-source LLM eval framework kimi prompts, models, RAG və agents-i test edir; caching və cost/token reporting workflows ilə istifadə olunur.
sample_project: 20 prompt variantı üçün accuracy, latency və cost table çıxar.
before_after_angle: Before: prompt seçimi manualdır. After: promptfoo ilə token-aware eval matrix var.

name: garak
problem_solved: LLM app-in prompt injection, jailbreak, leakage və hallucination weaknesses-ləri sistemli test olunmur.
what_it_does: NVIDIA-backed open-source LLM vulnerability scanner; prompt injection, data leakage, jailbreaks və digər probes işlədir.
sample_project: Own chatbot endpoint-inə garak prompt injection probe-ları run et.
before_after_angle: Before: security manual promptlarla yoxlanır. After: garak report vulnerable categories göstərir.

name: Dify
problem_solved: LLM app, RAG pipeline, workflow, agent və observability ayrı-ayrı qurulur.
what_it_does: Open-source LLM app platformu; knowledge base, RAG, agent workflow, model management və observability verir.
sample_project: Internal company policy assistant with uploaded PDFs, workflow routing, and citation-backed answers.
before_after_angle: Before: employees search policy PDFs manually. After: Dify knowledge base answers with citations and workflow actions.

name: RAGFlow
problem_solved: Complex PDFs, tables, scanned documents və formatted reports basic chunking ilə yaxşı işləmir.
what_it_does: Deep document understanding əsaslı open-source RAG engine; citations, parsing və enterprise RAG workflow verir.
sample_project: Financial report QA system that answers from PDFs with tables and citations.
before_after_angle: Before: naive PDF chunking loses tables and layout. After: RAGFlow gives citation-backed answers from complex documents.

name: Quivr
problem_solved: Personal və team knowledge base üçün fast, opinionated RAG core lazımdır.
what_it_does: Second brain-style RAG platform/core; any-file ingestion, custom RAG, tools və internet search support edir.
sample_project: Personal research knowledge base over PDFs, notes, and web articles.
before_after_angle: Before: notes and papers are searched by filename. After: Quivr retrieves semantically relevant knowledge.

name: MinerU
problem_solved: Scientific PDFs, formulas, tables and complex page layouts are hard to extract for KBs.
what_it_does: Open-source document extraction/conversion toolkit for PDFs and complex layouts.
sample_project: Academic paper KB that preserves formulas, tables and page structure.
before_after_angle: Before: formula/table evidence is lost. After: MinerU improves structured paper ingestion.

name: RTP-LLM
problem_solved: Industrial-scale LLM serving üçün production-proven, high-performance engine lazımdır.
what_it_does: Alibaba tərəfindən open-sourced LLM inference acceleration engine; batching, GPU memory management, prefill/decode separation və multi-hardware direction.
sample_project: High-throughput Qwen serving benchmark with RTP-LLM.
before_after_angle: Before: generic server high-load altında latency artırır. After: RTP-LLM industrial serving architecture göstərir.

name: Mooncake
problem_solved: Disaggregated LLM serving-də KV cache movement və reuse əsas bottleneck olur.
what_it_does: Moonshot AI/Kimi serving platform; Transfer Engine və Mooncake Store ilə KV-cache-centric disaggregated serving components verir.
sample_project: Repeated long-context workload üçün KV-cache reuse demo qur.
before_after_angle: Before: long prompt hər request-də recompute olunur. After: Mooncake-style cache store reuse göstərir.

name: BitNet.cpp
problem_solved: 1-bit / ternary LLM-lər üçün dedicated efficient inference framework lazımdır.
what_it_does: Microsoft BitNet repo daxilində official inference framework; 1-bit LLM inference, benchmarking və deployment üçün nəzərdə tutulub.
sample_project: BitNet b1.58 modelini CPU-da run edib normal quantized model ilə müqayisə et.
before_after_angle: Before: normal low-bit model still memory-heavy. After: 1-bit model much smaller memory footprint.

name: Feast
problem_solved: Real-time recommendations üçün fresh user/item/context features modelə çatmır.
what_it_does: Open-source feature store for defining, managing, discovering and serving features.
sample_project: E-commerce recommender using recent views, cart additions and purchase features.
before_after_angle: Before: model stale batch features ilə işləyir. After: Feast online features real-time personalization verir.
